en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an archaeological site with extensive stone ruins and a low rectangular building with a pitched roof in the middle ground. The ruins stretch across the foreground with a few small human figures walking among them, while gently rolling hills and a road appear in the background. On the right side of the card there is printed bilingual text in French and Greek identifying the site as the royal palace of Minos.
